item.title: Aggregate reports by account and currency
item.brief: Read currency-aware ledger CSV and aggregate totals by account and currency. Preserve support for legacy CSV without currency, defaulting to USD. Output header account,currency,total_cents, rows sorted by account then currency. Validate currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Add/update tests, run python3 -m unittest, update README. Commit the finished change locally.

pr.body: Updated reports.py to group by the account/currency pair, default currency to USD only when the CSV lacks the currency column, and reject invalid currency values with a stderr diagnostic and exit status 2. Updated README.md and added tests for currency-aware aggregation, deterministic ordering, legacy compatibility, and malformed codes. Verification: `python3 -m unittest` passed (3 tests); `git diff --check` passed. Assumption: a blank currency in a currency-aware CSV is invalid.
pr.summary: Reports now aggregate totals by account and currency, with legacy CSV defaulting to USD. Before: reports grouped by account only; now: currency-aware totals emit in account and currency order.

item.title: Support currency in ledger TSV to CSV
item.brief: Implement fourth TSV currency column; default missing currency to USD. Validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. Emit CSV header date,account,amount_cents,currency, writing currency on each row. Malformed currency must print an error naming input line number to stderr and exit 2; preserve exit 1 for other input errors. Add/update tests; run cargo test; update README. Commit the finished change locally.
